responsibility: This definition module declares the SHORTREAL variant of the gm2 elementary mathematics interface. It belongs to the numeric runtime library layer and exports constants such as pi and exp1 together with square root, exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric, arctangent, and integer-part procedures specialized for SHORTREAL values, distinguishing it from MathLib0 for REAL and LMathLib0 for LONGREAL.
same_name_distinction: Declaration half of the SMathLib0 pair: it publishes the SHORTREAL constants and procedure signatures, including which entries are compiler builtins, while the sibling implementation file contains the cbuiltin/libm bindings that realize those operations.
